subject: DEFINE directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.11.4 "that operand is treated as a literal, not as an arithmetic-expression" -> OK GR5. A lone numeric literal is not INTEGER-PART truncated (§7.3.6.3 GR3 would): p1b '>>DEFINE F AS 1.5' then '>>IF F = 1.5' selects, while '7 / 2' truncates to 3. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 - §7.3 compiler-directive facility; ISO/IEC 1989:2023 Annex E lists no change to §7.3.11 against 2014 (the 2002 introduction is not stated in the 2023 text itself; below 2002 the directive is COBOL0900)
